name: Dan Winter
tagline: Learning content people actually care about
headline: Customer Education · Learning Experience · Digital Design
summary: Learning experience designer with 15 years in customer education. I turn complicated software into courses, simulations, and interactive modules that people understand and finish. I lead the learning experience and digital design team at Okta, where we own the look and feel of our courses and the template system behind them. I like to work closely with the experts and stakeholders so the final thing is clear, accurate, and ships on time.
heroIntro:
Hi, I’m Dan.
By day I turn confusing software into courses people get through without sighing. By night I’m finishing jigsaw puzzles and painting tiny figures. It’s the same itch both ways: figure out how the pieces fit, then make it look good.
rolesLine: Learning experience · Customer education · Digital design
